verdict.rationale: Rippling documents building custom security policies from device/user attributes and reacting to risk signals with automated remediation and dynamic access rules, which supports condition-based access per app/group. However, explicit evidence of network- or location-based conditional policies is absent, and there's no detail on per-app/group conditional policy configuration granularity. Missing for 10: explicit network-context and location-based conditional access examples, and concrete per-app/group policy configuration workflow.
